influence_signals.text: 😢 (from UNTIL) "Dear comrade, This weekend, we planned to come together to present a united front against the European Migration Pact, its infrastructure, and the horrors of the violent racial capitalist system it represents. We made a clear calculation of the necessary number of registrations to carry out this action. A massive amount of support has been expressed, but the minimum number of registrations necessary to carry out the action successfully without an inadvisable level of risk, was not met. However, we do not want to compromise on our plan: we do not want to promise an attack on the infrastructure of Fortress Europe and all that it stands for, and then deliver anything less than that. The energy gathered around this cause is powerful and precious, and shouldn't be wasted. That's why we have decided that this weekend is not the moment for this action, rather than adapting the plan. We massively appreciate the support, trust, and courage from those of you who did sign up. We are so grateful to you for registering, and your commitment to make this action happen. We are really sorry for giving you this information so late. We know that you prepared yourself and that a change in plans can cause a lot of stress. We are also aware that signing up to participate in a mass action is a great act of trust. It involves giving up some autonomy and knowledge in order to achieve something of greater mass and impact. Organisers like us therefore have an important responsibility to make sure participants feel like they have the information and tools they need, and as much agency as possible. We are saying this also because our campaign does not end here. We will be in touch as soon as possible with more information about the next steps. This isn't a decision taken lightly - we make this choice with the strong belief that there is a huge amount of energy, rage and solidarity behind this cause. We will be in touch soon. See you soon, UNTIL" # Belgium # MassAction # MigrantRights # refugees # refugeesWelcome # FortressEurope # Europe # UNTILeveryoneIsFree
